workarounds.symptom: [Bug] RadixArk/Muse-Glimmer-NVFP4 fails at load since #45632 (MXFP8 lm_head), and on Hopper also at DeepGEMM warmup
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] quantization: Load Muse-Glimmer-NVFP4's MXFP8 lm_head, and run its MXFP8 dense layers as block-FP8 off Blackwell. Target files: python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/fp8.py, python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/modelopt_quant.py, test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_fp8_lm_head_mxfp8.py. `RadixArk/Muse-Glimmer-NVFP4` does not start with default flags. Loading fails on its MXFP8 `lm_head` (any GPU), and on Hopper the MXFP8 dense layers then fail in DeepGEMM warmup. (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48128)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] EPLB crashes with per_pass/per_token recorder modes
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] eplb: reject incompatible recorder modes. Target files: python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/parallel_hook.py, test/registered/npu/basic_function/parallel_strategy/expert_parallelism/test_npu_expert_distribution_recorder_mode.py, test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py. Combining `--enable-eplb` with `per_pass` or `per_token` is accepted at startup but crashes the scheduler on the first rebalance. EPLB requires object dumps, while these recorder modes only support file output. (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48404)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] PD + Mooncake: different DSA backends on prefill and decode silently corrupt the decode KV ("Requested address ... not found")
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] disaggregation: Reject a decode peer whose KV page stride differs at Mooncake registration. Target files: python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/mooncake/conn.py, test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_wire.py. - The Mooncake sender writes decode pages at `dst_ptr + page * item_len` using the prefill's `item_len`. When the roles allocate different KV layouts, every transfer silently corrupts the decode KV, and pages near the end of the pool overrun the layer buffer (`Requested address ... not found`). - ... (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/48231)
